en.title: Serbia snow conditions, 17 November 2026: depth, fresh snow and the next days
en.description: Serbia snow today, 17 November: snow cover, new snow, snow depth by height, the next days and the best resorts.
en.lede: The white area in Serbia stands at about 30 km² today, little changed from yesterday.

p: No height band is mostly white yet. Over the week the white area has hardly moved from 70 km².

sections.h: New snow in the last three days
p: Hardly any new snow fell in the last three days: the three-day maximum is 0 cm.
At the top of the list, Avantura park reports 3 cm.
Count 1 white resorts out of 9 in Serbia today.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: Little has changed on the ground, so the snow you find today is mostly the snow of the last storm.
The week ahead could bring up to 8 cm, 0 cm of it in the next three days.
Monday 23 November stands out, with up to 6 cm in a day.

advice: Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.
Snow above the tree line can be wind-packed: watch the ridges.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.

sr.title: Sneg u Srbiji danas: visina snežnog pokrivača i novi sneg, 17. novembra 2026.
sr.description: Sneg u Srbiji 17. novembra: snežni pokrivač, novi sneg, visina po nadmorskoj visini, naredni dani i najbolji ski-centri.
sr.lede: U Srbiji je danas pod snegom oko 30 km² (utorak, 17. novembra). Površina je gotovo ista kao jučer.

p: Nijedan visinski pojas još nije pretežno bel. Za sedam dana površina se gotovo nije promenila u odnosu na 70 km².
Poslednja tri dana gotovo nije padao sneg: maksimum je 0 cm.
Prednjači Avantura park: 3 cm na gornjem delu staza.
Ski-centri sa snegom na gornjim stazama: 1 od 9.
Malo promena: uređene staze su pouzdane, a sneg izvan njih stari i stvrdnjava se.
Nedelja može doneti do 8 cm, od toga do 0 cm u naredna tri dana.
Najsnežniji dan: ponedeljak, 23. novembra, do 6 cm.

advice: Iznad granice šume vetar može naneti sneg: oprezno na grebenima.
